meta.title: What we buy: diamonds, jewellery, watches | Valutazione Diamanti
meta.description: Our buying criteria: natural diamonds from 1 ct with GIA, HRD, IGI or no certificate, coloured gemstones, signed jewellery and luxury watches.

slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-009: What we buy and how to sell to us in Milan
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-010: Natural diamonds, fine gemstones, rare vintage jewellery and selected watches. Our valuations are free and carry no obligation: La Diamanteria makes its own offer directly.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-012: Natural diamonds of one carat or more per stone, with a GIA, HRD or IGI report, or without a report.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-015: Solitaires and jewellery with a main stone of one carat or more. Jewellery with several stones under one carat follows a dedicated path in the form.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-018: Rubies, sapphires and emeralds, including stones under two carats.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-021: Rare pieces, with particular attention to the quality of their gemstones.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-024: Selected brands only: Rolex, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, Cartier, Vacheron Constantin, Richard Mille, Piaget and Jacob & Co.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-027: We buy directly from private sellers. Whether you have inherited a piece of jewellery, wish to sell a loose stone or are considering selling a vintage piece, you can start with a free, no-obligation enquiry.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-029: Send clear photographs and a GIA, HRD or IGI report if you have one. We also consider diamonds without a report. Proof of identity is required if you decide to sell to us.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-031: We assess carat weight, colour, clarity and cut, alongside fluorescence, proportions, grading reports and the condition of the jewellery. For pieces with several stones, we collect additional details. An initial enquiry does not replace an in-person examination.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-033: Two stones of the same weight can have different values. Gemmological quality, any treatments, documentation and the item's characteristics all matter. We make our offer after examining the item.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-035: If needed, we arrange an appointment at Via Vincenzo Monti 47 in Milan to examine your item. If you accept our offer, we pay by bank transfer.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-037: We do not auction your diamond or offer it to a network of buyers. If it meets our requirements, we make you an offer ourselves. One point of contact for a straightforward process.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-039: Before sending your enquiry, please check that your item does not fall into these cases.
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-041: Diamonds under one carat as a single stone (jewellery with several stones follows a dedicated path in the form)
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-045: Diamonds accompanied by AIG, GRA, GWLAB or ALGT reports
slots.acquistiamo-contenuto-047: Watch brands other than those we buy: Rolex, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, Cartier, Vacheron Constantin, Richard Mille, Piaget and Jacob & Co
